title: The Pale Winter Anew
author: Ines Coldharbour
blurb: Casper Ashgrove, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
